'''2015 Texas Mini Worlds Stephen Skilton LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Skilton]] at [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stephen Skilton]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open We Have A Plan Skilton LS 2015 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130941/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]
